title: task.local_job — a batch job routed to a local executor (Ultron), never to Gilfoyle

kind.description: A job kind registered on the runner: vision_tag, text_batch, embeddings, transcribe (v1), folder_inventory.

inputs.description: Files/folders on Ultron, under the runner's allowed_roots.

model.description: Ollama model tag (e.g. llava:13b) or faster-whisper model (e.g. large-v3). Required by every kind except folder_inventory (model-free).

output.description: Output file (.json/.jsonl) or folder (transcribe) on Ultron or its Dropbox.

budget_minutes.description: Per-job wall-clock budget (active time; sleep doesn't count). Set per card; hours/overnight are normal.
